description: Find RETIREMENT and PASSIVE-INCOME residence routes (pensionado, rentista, retiree visas, financial-means residency) that qualify on income or savings, not an investment. Filter by monthly income in USD, income type (pension, passive or either), net worth, the most days a year you want to spend there, region, dependants, and whether foreign income must be untaxed. Each route returns its official requirement in its legal currency, whether you appear to qualify (indicative FX, flagged as such), the stay rule, how foreign income is taxed with a plain label (territorial, exempt, partial or worldwide: Mexico, Portugal, Colombia and Brazil tax the foreign pension of a tax resident), the path to permanent residence and citizenship, and the official source. Figures not yet verified are withheld (null), never estimated. Information, not advice.

dependants.description: Number of dependants (spouse, children) to include; routes with a per-dependant income add-on raise the requirement accordingly. Default 0.

foreign_income_untaxed_only.description: true = only routes where foreign income is untaxed for a tax resident (exempt, territorial or remittance basis). Default false.

income_type.description: What the income is: pension (state or private retirement pension), passive (rents, dividends, interest), or either/both. Default either.

max_stay_days_per_year.description: The most days a year you are willing to spend in the country. Routes with a higher stated minimum are excluded; routes whose stay rule is not stated are kept and flagged.

monthly_income_usd.description: Your regular monthly income in USD (pension and/or passive income). Optional; without it qualification by income is left open.

net_worth_usd.description: Liquid savings or investable net worth in USD, for routes that accept a deposit, savings balance or assets instead of income. Optional.

region.description: Region filter, case-insensitive: e.g. "Latin America", "Caribbean", "Europe", "Asia", "Middle East", "Americas".

name: find_retirement_routes

outputSchema.description: Mirabello response envelope. Tool-specific fields vary; the provenance/disclaimer envelope is always present.

book_url.description: Link to request a consultation with a Mirabello specialist, for a personal case.

data_updated.description: Date the underlying dataset was last updated.

disclaimer.description: Information, not legal/tax/financial/immigration advice; figures indicative.

error.description: Present only when the request could not be fulfilled.

source.description: Attribution for the data, when it is not Mirabello Consultancy itself.

title: Find Retirement & Passive-Income Residence
